correctness.rationale: The intrinsic decomposition into generators A and nonzero products B is unique and yields arbitrary surjective symmetric product tables. Labelled marking is inclusion–exclusion over B. The unlabelled polynomial follows from an orbitwise equivariant-color fixed-count formula and inclusion–exclusion over entire target permutation cycles, then Burnside. For each (m,k), all-zero diagonals have conditional frequency at most (k+1)^(-m), and if present require k<=binom(m,2); the two cases k<n/2 and k>=n/2 imply the displayed bound. Standalone independent brute-force checks reproduce full coefficient lists, actual isomorphism orbits and known unmarked totals. Finite-basis interpretation follows from the fully read October 2026 Corollary 1.2. No finite check is treated as an infinite proof.
